{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Hmm. So only one pocket watch was stolen?"}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "The shopkeeper, old Takanashi, sits in his chair staring at the floor."}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Don't call me Inspector. Akira's fine. Especially in front of Takanashi-san."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Understood, Akira"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "This is Nagi. She's only eighteen, but she's very dependable. Don't worry, Akira-san."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "That's a relief. She can handle the phone and the paperwork too."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Small talk can wait. Let's start the interview first."}, {"id": 1, "text": "Akira, may I hear from Takanashi-san first?"}]}

{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Akira, the forensics results are in. I'll share them with my senior right away too."}]}
{"t": [{"id": 0, "text": "Go on. ...Oh? The culprit is inside the shop."}]}
